text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important choices. One key idea is responsive design, which means an app should work well on different screen sizes and devices. Developers also decide between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one platform, while cross-platform apps can run on several, saving time but sometimes affecting performance. After building an app, developers publish it on app stores like Google Play or the App Store, where users can download it. Good performance is essential because slow or buggy apps frustrate users and often get deleted quickly.
